name: 状態集計と絞り込みを備えた取引管理表
prompt:
Create a very wide Stripe-style transaction management table image based closely on the supplied reference crop, preserving the panoramic approximately 1517:486 composition. Do not add a page title or recommendation banner. Show six summary cards in one row: “All 6”, “Succeeded 1”, “Refunded 0”, “Disputed 0”, “Failed 3”, “Uncaptured 0”. All cards are white with light neutral borders; show All selected using a small 2px official Lighthouse gradient accent along its top edge only (#174C36 to #1F6444 to #2D8F5E), with no tinted fill.
Below show the exact filter controls in this order: “Date and time”, “Amount”, “Currency”, “Status”, “Payment method”, “More filters”, each with a small neutral plus icon and light dashed outline. At the right show white outlined “Export” and “Edit columns” actions with neutral slate icons.
Below a thin neutral divider, show the visible table, keeping the right edge cropped as in the reference. Headers: select checkbox, “Amount”, “Payment method”, “Description”, “Customer”, “Date”, “Refunded date”, “Dispute amount”, and the beginning of “Dispute reason” clipped at the right edge.
Show exactly these six rows in order with fine neutral row dividers, light empty selection boxes and right-side ellipsis menus:
1. “US$1.00” and “USD”; payment “—”; description “Payment for Invoice”; customer “iamleonardkim@gmail.com”; date “6 Dec, 09:00”; refunded date “—”; dispute amount “—”; status Incomplete, with neutral slate clock icon/text. Keep the row's checkbox disabled-looking but unchecked.
2. “MYR 2.00” and “MYR”; Visa card ending “6442”; “Admin fee”; “iamleonardkim@gmail.com”; “6 Dec, 00:42”; refunded “—”; dispute “—”; status Succeeded with green check and green text on white.
3. “MYR 2.00” and “MYR”; Visa ending “0687”; “Admin fee”; same customer; “6 Dec, 00:41”; refunded “—”; dispute “—”; status Failed with red x and red text on white.
4. “MYR 2.00” and “MYR”; Visa ending “0687”; “Admin fee”; same customer; “6 Dec, 00:40”; refunded “—”; dispute “—”; status Failed with red x and red text on white.
5. “MYR 2.00” and “MYR”; Visa ending “3785”; “Admin fee”; same customer; “6 Dec, 00:35”; refunded “—”; dispute “—”; status Failed with red x and red text on white.
6. “US$1.00” and “USD”; payment “—”; description “Payment for Invoice”; same customer; “5 Dec, 19:05”; refunded “—”; dispute “—”; status Incomplete, with neutral slate clock icon/text.
Use white surfaces throughout, ink #1D1D1D, secondary text #6E6E6E, neutral slate icons #526173, thin light gray dividers. Status meanings may use green/red text and icons on white only. Keep the VISA brand mark navy on white with no colored tile. Do not use tinted fills, pastel badges, color washes, glow, extra rows or invented values. Keep text and columns legible at this wide aspect.
reviewNotes: Reviewed v1 against the saved 1517x486 Stripe reference crop. Preserves six status totals, filters, Export/Edit columns, six transaction rows, amounts/currencies, methods, descriptions, customer, dates and dash values. Status labels remain within the Amount column; no separate status column was added. White surfaces, official gradient only on selected All accent, no tinted status fills; semantic green/red text and icons only. Static image review only.
